tools.name: list_previews
tools.description: List all stored PDF drafts in this session. Returns previews[{preview_id, title}], count, and most_recent_preview_id. Use when the user taps List PDFs or asks which drafts exist. Does not show document body — follow with get_preview after they pick.

tools.name: get_preview
tools.description: Preview PDF button. Call with no args first: if one draft exists, returns document_markdown; if multiple, returns needs_selection + previews — emit_display layout P (interaction_mode none) numbered picker only. NEVER collect_user_input or emit_display input for preview_id. After user replies with a

tools.name: preview_document
tools.description: Write or revise draft markdown into session storage (creates preview_id). Agent-only — not a suggestion button. Use when the user asks to create/write/edit document content. For showing an existing draft use get_preview (Preview PDF). Never put emit_display chrome into content.

tools.name: generate_pdf
tools.description: Generate a PDF from a preview. Call with no args first: if multiple previews exist, returns needs_selection + previews (title + preview_id) — ask the user which one, then call again with preview_id. If only one preview exists, generates it immediately. Returns pdf_url when generated.

tools.name: delete_preview
tools.description: Delete one stored PDF draft by preview_id from this chat session only. Hidden from suggestion buttons — agent-only. Returns deleted true/false. Does not remove already-generated public PDF files. Never accept path-like ids.

tools.name: get_network_identity
tools.description: Where this user's requests to the site leave from (a VPN country, the server, or the app's default) and which browser they present. Read-only.

tools.name: set_network_identity
tools.description: Choose where this user's requests to the site leave from and which browser they present, only when the user asks (e.g. 'connect through Nigeria', 'use my own user agent'). Sites may ask the user to sign in again when this changes. reset=true goes back to how they signed in.
